SKI is a hardcore, fast-paced skiing game.

Reaching the bottom isn’t easy,learn the controls, keep your speed, and avoid crashing.

Race friends, find the fastest lines, send huge jumps, land tricks, and chase world records. Every mistake costs time.

Mobile — Swipe right side / Hold or Double Tap Jump
Controller — D-Pad / X

Private server owners can change course length and difficulty from the top bar.

👍 Like and favorite for new skis, features, and updates

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Coin Farm, Auto Ski and Auto Quest + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for a Roblox ski game uses FishyUI and opens with RightAlt, attaching to the game's own live client modules so it drives the same ski state and run flow the game steps every frame. Auto coin farm routes the body coin to coin while keeping the run alive, with two movement modes: teleport, which writes CFrame straight onto each coin (no collision sweep, so nothing to hit on the way), and glide, which steps under the game's broad-phase band so the swept grab segment picks up whatever lies between coins. It reopens runs when they drop, clicks the game's own continue prompt after a wreck to skip the twenty-second timeout, and cycles the run once the server's per-run payout cap is reached. Quest handling ranks all roughly forty rotation quests, holds the six the farm can actually finish (coin, score, airtime, maxair, survive), swaps out ones it can't drive, and asks for finished ones — while skipping kinds like trick, ring and wallride that need input the farm never makes, and distance quests the server won't credit for a teleport. Live panels show ski state, credited coins, picked up, coins per minute, run count, quests held, quests completed, and XP, alongside a log of key events. Anti-AFK keeps the client from idling out, and a settings tab documents the game's own numbers — grab radius, stuck watchdog, run cap, and quest slots — plus whether live tables were verified. Theme and config saving work through FishyUI's addons but degrade gracefully if either is missing.

SKI, SKI ALPHA

Update Log & Feature List (2026-09-26)

Perfect Landings: Makes every landing register as perfect.



No Crash: Prevents wipeouts entirely.



Always Land Tricks: Forces every trick to land regardless of angle.



Wall & Mountain Noclip: Ski directly through mountains and walls without falling through the map.



Tree & Rock Noclip: Ski straight through trees and rocks.



Hole Bridges: Automatically creates bridges across every hole in the course.



Auto Unstick: Instantly frees you whenever you become stuck.



Fast Tricks: Reduces trick cooldown down to 25%.

SKIING & AUTOMATION





Auto Ski:





Auto Ski: Automatically navigates down the course using best-path routing while avoiding obstacles. Features Presets (Coin Hunter, Safe Finish, Center Line), Ski Actions (Chase Boost Pickups, Chase Coins, Perfect Pop, Tuck For Speed), and sliders for Look Ahead, Obstacle Margin, and Run Delay.



Auto Tricks:





Auto Tricks: Automatically performs and chains tricks while skiing. Features Presets (Max Score, Safe), selectable tricks (Flips, Grabs, Rolls, Shifties, Spins), Trick Actions (Chain Combos, Ground Hops, Stack Spins, Switch Tricks), Flip Direction (Backflip, Frontflip), and a Landing Margin slider.



Coin Magnet:





Coin Magnet: Automates expanded coin collection with Presets (Wide Grab, Max Grab), Magnet Actions (Force Magnet, Widen Grab), and an adjustable Grab Radius from 18-600. Pasted text

BYPASS & RUN MODS





Crash Mods:





Crash Mods: Features Presets (Blatant, No Noclip) and actions including Always Land Tricks, Auto Unstick, Hole Bridges, No Crash, Tree & Rock Noclip, and Wall & Mountain Noclip. Includes customizable Bridge Transparency and bridge materials (Force Field, Glass, Neon, Smooth Plastic).



Run Mods:





Run Mods: Features Presets (Blatant, Buffs Only) with Fast Tricks, Keep Magnet Buff, and Keep Points Buff, plus a configurable Trick Cooldown slider.



Score Mods:





Score Mods: Features Presets (Blatant, Landings Only) with Max Multiplier, Perfect Landings, and Score Boost, including adjustable scoring from 1x-100x. Pasted text

REWARDS & PROGRESSION





Auto Claim:





Auto Claim: Automatically handles reward claiming with Presets (Everything, Daily Only), reward types (Codes, Daily, Quest Tracking), and a configurable Claim Delay.



Auto Challenges:





Auto Challenges: Automates challenge progression using Presets (Lowest Medal First, Bronze Everything) and a configurable Target Medal.



Auto Crates:





Auto Crates: Automatically opens and optionally purchases crates using Presets (Open Owned, Buy And Open), Crate Actions (Buy Crates, Open Crates), and Buy Amount / Coin Reserve sliders.



Auto Rebirth:





Auto Rebirth: Automatically handles rebirth progression using Presets (Cosmetic Unlocks, Endless Rebirths) with Stop At Rebirth and Rebirth Delay controls.



Crew Filler:
